title: Median-of-Means for Nash Equilibrium Seeking in Heavy-Tailed Games
summary: This paper studies the Nash equilibrium seeking problem for stochastic games under heavy-tailed noise. The gradient noise is considered to have a finite $δ$-th moment ($1<δ\le 2$), which generalizes the Gaussian noise and covers cases with infinite variance. In this work, we employ the classic method Median-of-Means (MoM) in robust estimation. MoM works by dividing samples into blocks, taking the average of each block, and then taking the median of these block averages, achieving a breakdown point of up to $1/2$.
